## Frequently Asked Questions

General Pricing Questions

- What currency does Spacelift use for pricing?







Spacelift is priced in U.S. dollars (USD).

- Which payment methods can we use?







We accept multiple forms of payment, depending on the type of plan you choose. For example, the monthly subscription for the Starter plan can be paid for via a credit card. The Enterprise plan can be paid for via purchase order and invoice or with a credit card on a monthly or annual basis. Spacelift can also be purchased and paid via the AWS and Azure marketplaces. See additional information below.

- What is a worker and how does it fit into the pricing structure?







A worker is a predefined set of compute resources that are specifically optimized for the development, provisioning, and deployment of cloud-based infrastructures based on IaC. Spacelift provides two types of workers: public and private.

- What's the difference between a public and a private worker?







Public workers are a type of worker that is provided and managed by Spacelift in a common secure worker pool. Each customer run is executed in its own isolated container instance. Although the underlying compute resources within the public worker pool are shared, runs do not have any access to the source or state of other accounts.



Private workers are a type of worker that are provided and managed by Spacelift, but are hosted as a customer-managed asset within their private cloud environment. They are securely connected to the Spacelift application for provisioning and management.

- Can I adjust my plan if I decide I don't need all the features of my current plan?







Although we can’t remove features or remove workers from an annual subscription, if your usage or needs are lower than you anticipated, please [contact sales](https://spacelift.io/contact)and we will be happy to work with you. We have a number of options to help you right-size your plan so you can ensure you have what you need.

- Are there multiyear subscription options?







Yes, Starter, Business, and Enterprise can be purchased as multiyear subscriptions. Please [request a quote](https://spacelift.io/contact?refid=request-quote) to discuss multiyear agreements.

- Are there partners or integrators that we can contact to purchase a subscription for Spacelift?







Yes, please [contact the Spacelift Sales](https://spacelift.io/contact) team for more information.

- Do you offer pricing options for government and nonprofit organizations?







Yes, we offer pricing options for government and nonprofit organizations, please [request a quote](https://spacelift.io/contact?refid=request-quote) to learn more.

- Are the plans available through the Amazon Marketplace?







Yes, all of our plans are available for purchase through the Amazon Marketplace. You can find Spacelift under the SaaS product category and access the Spacelift page on Amazon Marketplace [here](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-drrpy7qnpny5s?sr=0-1&ref_=beagle&applicationId=AWSMPContessa).

- Will procuring via the AWS Marketplace count towards my Private Pricing Agreement (PPA) commitment??







Yes, Spacelift qualifies as a SaaS partner to count towards your PPA commitment.

- Are the plans available through the Azure Marketplace?







Yes, all of our plans are available for purchase through the Azure Marketplace. You can find Spacelift under the SaaS product category and access the Spacelift page on Azure Marketplace [here](https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/saas/spaceliftinc1746041787715.spacelift?tab=Overview).


Starter Plan

- How does the Starter plan subscription work?







The Starter plan is offered as an annual subscription. In cases where a proof of concept is run, no further setup is required as the evaluation license is converted to a full license.

- Can I cancel the Starter plan after the subscription starts?







If you’re on a Starter annual plan, you can cancel up to 14 days after an executed contract if the software has not been activated. After 14 days, the plan can’t be cancelled. If the software has been activated, the plan can not be canceled.


Business Plan

- How does the Business plan subscription work?







The Business plan is offered as an annual subscription. In cases where a proof of concept is run, no further setup is required as the evaluation license is converted to a full license.

- Can the business plan subscription be paid for annually?







Yes, the Business plan can be paid for annually. Payment would be made at the beginning of the term.

- Can I cancel the Business plan after the subscription starts?







If you’re on an annual plan, you can cancel up to 14 days after an executed contract if the software has not been activated. After 14 days, the plan can’t be cancelled. If the software has been activated, the plan can not be canceled.

- Can I have more private workers in the Business plan?







Yes, you can upgrade to a Business plan that includes additional private workers when purchasing Spacelift, or you can upgrade after onboarding by getting in touch with the CS team.


Enterprise / Self-Hosted Plan

- How does the Enterprise or Self-Hosted plan subscription work?







The Enterprise and Self-Hosted plans are offered as annual subscriptions. In cases where a proof of concept is run, no further setup is required as the evaluation license is converted to a full license.

- Can I cancel the Enterprise or Self-Hosted plan?







If you’re on an annual plan, you can cancel up to 14 days after an executed contract if the software has not been activated. After 14 days, the plan can’t be cancelled. If the software has been activated, the plan can not be canceled.
